description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
The Windows suite runs in three jobs, the Rendering part's rest in six processes over the last two, so no part comes near its limit on the slowest runner.
The engine's comments say what the code is as it stands, in its own terms, naming no game, scene or product as the reason and telling no fault, trial or reading of what the code was.
The model pass reads a surface's point where the samples a triangle covers lie, as its normal and colors, so a face seen nearly edge on takes its light at a point on itself, and the guide says which values a program's own stage reads so.
A mesh's colors and second coordinates are read where the samples a triangle covers lie, so at four samples a pixel a face seen nearly edge on no longer draws a white pixel, and light.terms reads a pixel's light by its terms.
title: 3DEngine
